title: WorkshopVersionLink
description: An immutable pointer from a workshop to a Strategy Registry version. A workshop version is a link, not a copy of the StrategySpec document. StrategySpec JSON, lifecycle, ExperimentRun, and CandidateArtifact truth remain exclusively in the Strategy Registry.

workshop_version_id.description: Immutable identifier for this workshop-version link.

strategy_id.description: Stable strategy identity across Registry versions. Copied from the resolved Registry record; not synthesized locally.

strategy_spec_registry_id.description: Immutable Registry record/version ID this link points to. The pointed record is the single source of StrategySpec JSON truth.

parent_workshop_version_id.description: The preceding workshop-version link in the same workshop, or null for the first link.

source_event_id.description: The workshop event that caused this version link to be created.

sequence_no.description: Monotonically increasing version counter within the workshop.

created_by.description: Actor reference (user_id or persona_id) that created this link.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this link was created.
